roadmap--blocked-item-compact-dark.png.task: Read a selected work item's state and purpose without repeated heading space.
roadmap--blocked-item-compact-dark.png.observations: The complete approval blocker is now visible immediately after title, blocked state and section selector in the compact view. Current dependency information precedes suggested changes; the header and controls fit without clipping in both appearances.
